name: Hero: the Creation, in daylight

credit.desktop: Nano Banana Pro 4K repaint of the hero (hero2 d1, judged 2026-10-21: mean luma 0.49 at 1440x900 vs Editions 0.33; Laplacian variance 657/550 vs 658/462), same two figures and reach, no floating kit, the fingertip gap empty sky; local retouch (zero credit): the sunglasses-arm emblem cloned out, the AI hatch strokes and dust in the lower-right bushes softened (median + bilateral, 70%), the blue hues graded to ~55% saturation (sky RGB 90,177,237 -> 152,203,237). scratchpad hero3h/retouch.py
credit.phone: the 'reach' crop of the retouched desktop master: 9:16 at full height (1728x3072), centred on the fingertip gap (desktop uv x 0.334-0.648); the hands and the gap in, the bodies out, so the 3D camera sits truly between the fingertips on phones (every portrait repaint failed the gap check: p4's gap was 0.043 W)

desktop.advice: none: ink type with a cream halo; a cream frosted panel behind the dek and index over the pines

phone.advice: none: ink type; a cream panel behind the dek and index over the landscape

masterpiece: after Michelangelo, The Creation of Adam (c. 1512)
artNote: Light, Editions-like: the golden frame sits centred over the reach (titleBox: the frame at 1440x900 and, on phones, at 390x844), its type in ink with a cream halo (the sky behind it is bright). propBox: the empty sky between the fingertips (his tip at uv 0.432, 0.397; hers at 0.550, 0.355), where the real-time 3D camera floats (centred at propCentre, about 0.08 of the painting's width); phones keep the gap at the screen's centre line (gap 178 css px at 390x844). faces: the two faces (the construction lines are masked off them).
